Figure S1 IAGOS ozone versus CO concentrations in the free troposphere (750‐350 hPa) over East Asia (30.0‐45.0 ° N, 109.0‐145.0 ° E), Europe (35.0‐54.0 ° N, ‐11.0‐30.0 ° E), and the United States (28.0‐49.0 ° N, ‐124.6.0‐ ‐66.8 ° E) for March‐August 2015‐2019. Ozone and CO column mixing ratios are computed from individual vertical profiles averaged over 25 hPa pressure levels. Ozone column mixing ratios are then averaged over bins of 5 ppb CO. Only bins with 50 or more observations are included.
